comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. GitHub #592's design (mitcad#2291; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/fillet-tight-rim-corner-reported-test.cmake): a block 30 x 10 x 20 (Extrude1 F13) whose top meets a concave quarter cylinder of radius 10 (the cut-out, its axis in the top's plane). Fillet1 (F14) rounds the end face's edge with the cut-out with d4 = 2, Fillet2 (F15) the end face's edge with the top with d5 = 3; its chain runs on round Fillet1's arc on the top and along the top's edge with the cut-out. Before, the corner was the acute tight corner of the port's patch 1590: its torus ran back over Fillet1's rounding (0.03 mm off it) and the cut-out's rounding was carried past its contact with the cut-out, a face of 0.0063 mm2: the roundings did not join cleanly. With the port's patch 2291 the corner is obtuse at the ball's contact with the cut-out, and Fillet1's own ball closes it. One valid solid, no warning, no face under 0.01 mm2.
The volume of the same block rounded so by OCCT alone (geometry.port.2291: 4355.522880; before the patch the reported design had 4355.487).
Fillet2 with Fillet1's radius 2: no tight corner, the ball stays put round Fillet1's arc; clean as before, the volume geometry.port.2291's (4388.488279) and the design's before the patch.
